synopsis: Crochet your own characters, creatures, costumes, and more from George Lucas's epic film saga with Star Wars: Crochet Your Way Across the Galaxy - the ultimate guide to creating stunning projects inspired by a galaxy far, far away. . . . Use the Force to crochet incredible projects with this official Star Wars crochet pattern book. Featuring beautiful projects in stunning full-color photography, Star Wars: Crochet Your Way Across the Galaxy includes patterns for toys, apparel, and home decor inspired by your favorite movie moments, characters (both sentient and non-sentient), droids, ships, and more. The patterns are designed for crocheters at all skill levels, making it the perfect book for crocheters across the galaxy. CONTENT FOR EVERY CROCHETER: More than 25 patterns for crocheters of every skill level, along with varied crochet stitches and techniques. FILLED WITH FULL-COLOR PHOTOGRAPHY: Includes gorgeous full-color photos of projects and patterns to help ensure crocheting success, as well as celebrate beloved moments from the saga. CREATE CLOTHING, COSTUMES, AND MORE: Create classic amigurumi toys from your favorite Star Wars film or show, as well as beautiful clothing, costumes, and home goods inspired by iconic moments and characters from the galaxy far, far away. COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION: Craft and cook your way through the galaxy with Star Wars: Knitting the Galaxy, Star Wars: Everyday, Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook, and Star Wars: The Life Day Cookbook, also available
title: Star Wars: The Official Crochet Pattern Book
